_comment: SYNTHETIC test calls written for development. Not real customers. 'expect' is the known answer used to check the playbooks.

lines: Hello sir, I'm Rohit from SecureLife. I saw you enquired about term insurance.
Yes, I wanted to take something for my family. I have a wife and two kids, the younger one is only four.
Very good. And what is your annual income, if you don't mind?
About 18 lakh a year. I also have a home loan of around 40 lakh.
Do you have any existing cover?
Only the 10 lakh my company gives me. Nothing personal.
Then you need at least 1.5 crore. I recommend a 1 crore 50 lakh term plan till age 60. The premium is 24,000 rupees per year.
That sounds a bit high. Is there anything cheaper? I'd like to think about it and compare.
Sir, this rate is only valid till tonight. Tomorrow the premium will go up by 20 percent, so you must buy today.
Okay, but what about critical illness? My father had a heart problem.
We can add a critical illness rider for 4,000 more per year. Shall I send the payment link right now?
Alright, send it. My wife is the nominee.
Good morning, this is Priya from Metro Motors. You enquired about the Hyundai Creta.
Yes, I'm looking at the SX variant, the 2026 model. What is the on-road price?
On-road comes to about 17.8 lakh. Are you planning to finance or pay cash?
Loan. I can put down 3 lakh. I also have an old i20 to trade in.
With 3 lakh down, the EMI is around 28,000 for 60 months. We can value your i20 at the showroom.
Okay. Can I test drive it first?
Of course. Would Saturday at 11 work?
Saturday 11 is fine. Please also check if you have it in white.
Done, Saturday 11 am, white SX test drive booked. I will send you the confirmation.
Hi, this is Maya from Skyline Realty about the 3 bedroom apartment you enquired on.
Yes. We are relocating for my husband's job in about four months so we need to move fast.
Great. What budget are you looking at?
Up to 1.2 crore. We are already pre-approved by HDFC for 90 lakh and have 30 lakh as down payment.
Perfect. Do you have a preferred area?
Whitefield or Sarjapur. We also have to sell our flat in Pune first, and my husband will decide with me.
I can show you three options this weekend. Shall I book a site visit on Sunday?
Hello, this is Anil from QuickCash Finance. You applied for a personal loan.
Yes, I need 5 lakh for my sister's wedding.
Are you salaried or self employed?
Salaried, 85,000 a month, at an IT company for six years. I have one car loan EMI of 12,000.
Good. You are eligible. 5 lakh for 36 months, the EMI will be about 16,500.
What is the interest rate and are there any charges?
Don't worry about that, it's all very competitive. Just send me your salary slips and PAN and Aadhaar and we will disburse tomorrow.
Okay, I will send them in an hour.
Hi, this is Sam from GreenLeaf Landscaping. We are offering a garden redesign package this month.
I have a small backyard, about 200 square feet. What would it cost?
For that size, around 1,200 dollars including plants and two days of labour.
That's reasonable. My wife handles the garden though, let me ask her and call you back on Friday.
Sure, I'll note Friday and send you our before and after photos.
